profiles.name: Embedded Software Engineering (Industry)
profiles.text: Embedded Software Engineer with hands-on experience in C-based firmware development for embedded networking devices. Strong foundation in embedded programming, networking protocols, system debugging, and problem-solving. Seeking to design, develop, and maintain reliable C/C++ embedded systems while continuously advancing my expertise in embedded software and computer architecture.

profiles.name: Academic & Higher Education (Lecturer in CSE)
profiles.text: Passionate about teaching and committed to continuous learning, I seek a Lecturer position in Computer Science & Engineering at DIU. With experience mentoring university students locally and internationally, I strive to make complex topics accessible from multiple perspectives. My research interests in computer architecture, operating systems, and AI/ML motivate me to foster a research-driven environment and mentor students in innovative projects. I aim to contribute to DIU's academic excellence through engaging instruction, collaborative research, and student-centered mentorship.

profiles.name: Hardware Systems & Processor Architecture (VLSI)
profiles.text: I have a strong interest in hardware-oriented system design and low-level computing, and I enjoy understanding how software concepts map onto real hardware. I have previously designed and implemented a working 4-bit CPU, including its control unit, memory module, and instruction set, which motivated me to explore deeper aspects of processor design beyond logic-level implementation. Through this course on Digital VLSI Physical Design, I aim to gain practical knowledge of physical design concepts and industry workflows that will help me progress toward my long-term goal of building complete CPU systems, including their ISA and supporting toolchains, with a solid foundation in real silicon implementation.

profiles.name: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI & Social Impact)
profiles.text: I am interested in exploring why many people in Bangladesh are still unable to fully benefit from modern technology, even though technological growth has been very rapid lately. Through Human-Computer Interaction research, I want to observe these gaps from the perspective of users and society and explore solutions that people can actually use and benefit from. By engaging with HCCS, I hope to learn research methods, shape my ideas, and actively contribute to projects that address digital inequality.

items.company: Shanghai BDCOM Information Technology Co., Ltd. (Bangladesh Office)
bullets: Developed and maintained C-based firmware for GPON/EPON ONU and Ethernet switch products on Linux- and VxWorks-based embedded platforms.
Designed and implemented a TFTP-based firmware upgrade solution for embedded Ethernet switch devices.
Implemented, customized, and validated networking features including DHCPv4, DHCPv6, PPPoE, IGMP, MLD, OMCI, TR-069, VLAN, and Ethernet switching.
Customized firmware for international ISP customers and ensured interoperability with Huawei and ZTE OLTs.
Implemented and validated multicast features including IGMP/MLD snooping, multicast VLAN, fast leave, static multicast groups, and multicast access control.
Investigated protocol-level issues using Wireshark, protocol analysis, and embedded CLI debugging to resolve customer-reported firmware defects.
Designed and executed functional, interoperability, and regression test cases for embedded networking features.

Conducted experimental systems projects in C (Student Information Management, Network Packet Management, BitMap Management) focusing on pointer manipulation, low-level data structures, and memory efficiency.
Used SVN for source code management, version control, and collaborative firmware development.
Collaborated with international customers and cross-functional teams to investigate firmware issues, provide technical support, and deliver customer-specific solutions.

items.name: 4-bit CPU Design
bullets: Designed and implemented a fully functional 4-bit CPU at the register-transfer level, including an ALU, register file, RAM, program counter, status flags, and an FSM-based control unit.
Designed a custom instruction set architecture (ISA) and assembly language, implementing the complete instruction fetch--decode--execute cycle.
Demonstrated strong understanding of computer architecture, digital logic design, datapath/control design, and hardware-software interaction.

items.name: Network Packet Management
bullets: Developed a packet management system in C to parse captured UDP packets into linked-list and hash-table data structures with reference counting and efficient packet lookup.
Applied low-level memory management, pointer manipulation, and data structure optimization for packet processing.

items.name: Student Information Management
bullets: Developed a console-based student information management system in C using doubly linked lists and modular programming.
Implemented file-based persistent storage with complete CRUD operations for departments, students, and academic records.

items.name: BitMap Set Library
bullets: Implemented a memory-efficient Bitmap Set Library in C supporting dynamic creation, cloning, value management, string parsing, and bitwise operations (NOT/AND/OR/XOR).

items.name: Handwritten Digit Recognizer
bullets: An AI-based deep learning project using Python and Deep Neural Networks (DNN) for optical digit recognition.

items.name: Re-Trip
bullets: A web-based application designed to resell and manage train ticket reservations.

Provided sustained academic mentoring to undergraduate and pre-university students in Computer Science, Engineering, and Mathematics, emphasizing analytical thinking, problem-solving, and strong programming fundamentals.

Taught core Computer Science courses including C/C++ Programming, Embedded Systems, Computer Networks, Database Systems, Digital Logic Design, Computer Architecture, Microprocessors & Assembly Language, and Peripherals & Interfacing.

Designed and demonstrated hands-on embedded C programming exercises involving GPIO, timers, UART communication, LCD interfacing, PWM-based LED breathing effects, DC motor control, and stepper motor control.
Delivered instruction in foundational and advanced mathematics, including Linear Algebra, Numerical Methods, Differential & Integral Calculus, and Ordinary/Partial Differential Equations.
Covered theoretical computer science topics such as Finite Automata, Formal Languages & Compiler Design, and Soft Computing, emphasizing formal reasoning and algorithmic thinking.

Mentored students from international universities, including the University of Bridgeport (USA) and the University of Wollongong (Australia), as well as leading universities in Bangladesh including NSU, AUST, and AIUB.
Conducted supplementary lectures and peer mentoring at the university level on challenging technical subjects.
Successfully guided HSC/SSC students and engineering admission candidates, with multiple students gaining admission to leading engineering universities in Bangladesh.
